PROP-57888860-inv-053.text: Batch KZG proof verification must validate that no input commitment is the point at infinity before aggregating commitments into the random linear combination. The point at infinity in a batch cancels its contribution to the pairing equation, allowing forged proofs for that commitment to pass undetected.
PROP-57888860-inv-053.assertion: forall batch in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch: forall i: commitments[i] != G1_IDENTITY, OR the aggregation must weight identity-point commitments such that verification still detects invalid proofs

locations.note: Main batch verification entry. Deduplicates commitments (line 79), deserializes at line 96, then passes to verify_multi_opening at line 103.
Performs random linear combination of commitments (lines 216-225 via g1_lincomb). Identity points would contribute 0 to the sum, canceling their verification.
Batch deserialization of commitments. Relies on blstrs for identity validation.
Hashes commitments into Fiat-Shamir challenge. Identity points in hash input could affect challenge generation.
